categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request parsing machinery in src/rpc/request.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a JSON-RPC batch error-handling bug where non-object batch elements reuse the previous element's ID or have their error dropped if the prior call was a notification. As pinheadmz noted, this resolves a specification violation that could confuse downstream consumers expecting unique batch IDs, though it only impacts malformed batch elements.
